ModMetaData.name: Agent Translation Bridge
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Agent Translation
ModMetaData.description:
Optional companion of the Agent Translation pack (rwat).
Reports which pack translations are actually in effect in the game (and which ones another mod overrides), shows the result under Options > Mod settings, and can reload Keyed translations without restarting (experimental, off by default).
Reads and writes only its own folder AgentTranslation\bridge inside the game's data folder (next to Saves and Config). Opens no network port. Never changes other mods.
